description: Use when reviewing an everyday store purchase before payment. Basic is free supplied-data rules only; explicitly selected deep adds public observations and a signed receipt for 0.01 USDC. No trial, purchase or automatic upgrade. Review a proposed store purchase before payment: free basic checks supplied rules, price, domain lookalikes and text; explicitly selected deep costs 0.01 USDC and adds bounded public domain/page/phishing observations plus a signed decision receipt. Missing evidence means wait, never a safe-store guarantee. No shared trial, login, purchase, automatic upgrade or target payment. Price: 0.01 deep; basic free USDC. Minimal input example: {"url":"https://example.com/shop","item_text":"Blue notebook","quoted_price":"19.99","currency":"USD","mode":"basic","rules":{"currency":"USD","max_per_order":"25","ask_above":"20"}}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"decision":"hold","display_decision":"wait","reasons":["spending_rules_missing"],"signed_receipt":false,"mode":"basic"}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): Basic is free, no external evidence or signature; explicitly choose deep for 0.01 USDC, no shared trial or automatic upgrade. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

currency.description: Required. Three-letter currency label. Example: USD.

item_text.description: Required. Item description string, treated as untrusted data. Example: Blue notebook.

mode.description: Optional. Basic is free/offline/unsigned; deep explicitly costs 0.01 USDC. Example: basic.

quoted_price.description: Required. Nonnegative decimal string, up to six fractional digits; no exchange conversion. Example: 19.99.

reference_price.description: Optional. Caller-supplied reference, not a verified market price. Example: {"amount":"20","currency":"USD"}.

amount.description: Required. Caller-supplied reference price as a decimal string. Example: 20.

currency.description: Required. Three-letter currency label. Example: USD.

rules.description: Optional. Caller rules; missing rules produce wait. Example: {"currency":"USD","max_per_order":"25"}.

allowed_stores.description: Optional. Allowed canonical domains including subdomains. Example: ["example.com"].

ask_above.description: Optional. Decimal price above which human review is required. Example: 20.

blocked_stores.description: Optional. Blocked canonical domains, taking priority over allowed stores. Example: ["example.org"].

currency.description: Required. Three-letter currency label. Example: USD.

max_per_order.description: Required. Maximum order price as a decimal string in the rule currency. Example: 25.

url.description: Required. Public HTTPS store URL without queries or credentials. Example: https://example.com/shop.
